# 2026 Temporary Generation RFP

PSEG Long Island, LLC (“PSEG Long Island”), on behalf of the Long Island Power Authority (“LIPA”) is issuing this 2026 Request for Proposals for Temporary Generation (“2026 Temporary Generation RFP” or “RFP”) for the purpose of maintaining reliability for Long Island customers. LIPA is seeking to procure up to a total of 400 MW of temporary generation from multiple Projects to be located in LIPAs service territory. Such facilities will be connected to LIPA’s Transmission or Distribution System (“LIPA’s T&D System”).

All RFP documents can be accessed via the Power Advocate platform at the following link: [PowerAdvocate RFP 238662: 2026 Temporary Generation RFP](https://www.poweradvocate.com/pR.do?okey=238662&pubEvent=true)

If you have any questions or issues accessing the Power Advocate platform, please send an email to: [PSEG-LI-2026TemporaryGenerationRFP@psegliny.com](mailto:PSEG-LI-2026TemporaryGenerationRFP@psegliny.com)

* * *

**RFP Target Dates**

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Activity** | **Target Date** |
| Release of RFP | July 27, 2026 |
| Question Submittal Window | July 28 - October 16, 2026 |
| Webinar | August 5, 2026, 11:00 AM EPT |
| LIPA Site Visit(s) | August 20 and August 27, 2026 |
| Notification of Intent to Bid | October 16, 2026 5:00PM EPT |
| Proposal Submittal Deadline | October 30, 2026 5:00 PM EPT |
| Proposal Selection(s) | January 22, 2027 |
| PPA Negotiations Completed | April, 2027 |
| LIPA Board of Trustees Approval\* | May, 2027 |
| Firm Pricing Required Through | September, 2027 |
| NY State Approvals (Effective Date)\*\* | September 2027 |
| Service Commencement Date(s) | May 1, 2028 - May 1, 2030 |

_\\* Any contract for Products from any proposed Project will not be executed until after the Project has received the requisite environmental permits. See Section 2.7.1_

_\\*\\* Approvals as required by NYS Attorney General and NYS Office of State Comptroller. Note: these dates are estimates._
